en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Al Khaybari, from Yunus Bin Zabyan and Mufazzal Bin Umar, and Abu Salma Al Sarraj and Al Husayn Bin Suweyr Bin Abu Fakhta who said,

‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘With us<sup>asws</sup> there are treasures of the earth and their keys, and had I<sup>asws</sup> so desired to, I<sup>asws</sup> would be saying (gesturing) with one of my<sup>asws</sup> legs: ‘Bring out whatever is inside you from the gold!’ It would bring it out’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> said (gestured) it with one of his<sup>asws</sup> legs, and marked the ground with a marking, so the ground burst out. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said (gestured) with his<sup>asws</sup> hand, so a gold ingot came out of a measurement of a palm’s width. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Look properly’. So we looked and there were many ingots, on top of each other, shining.

So, one of us said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! You (Imams<sup>asws</sup>) have been Given what you<sup>asws</sup> have been Given, and your<sup>asws</sup> Shias are needy’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Gathering for us<sup>asws</sup> and for our<sup>asws</sup> Shias, the world and the Hereafter, and He<sup>azwj</sup> will Enter them into the Gardens of Bliss, and He<sup>azwj</sup> would Enter our<sup>asws</sup> enemies into the Blazing Fire’.
